fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our annual fuel consumption, a hypothetical 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased into-plane aircraft fuel cost for 2024 by $147.9 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: Filing states 'from time to time' uses derivatives but no active positions. No fuel derivative activity since 2015.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed (thousands) 551,819 [2024] 591,796 [2023] (6.8)% [from 2024 Annual Report operating statistics table, in thousands]; Aircraft fuel expense decreased by 18.8% from $1,820.5 million in 2023 to $1,478.8 million in 2024 due to 6.8% decrease in fuel gallons consumed.
